Staff Data Engineer

at Acme Analytics
Remote, United States

Acme Analytics helps hospitals understand their own data. Our pipelines move billions of records a day and the people who rely on them are clinicians, so correctness matters more than speed.

What you will do

  • Own the ingestion platform built on Spark, Airflow and dbt.
  • Set the standards for data quality checks and make them easy to adopt.
  • Mentor four engineers and review the designs of two partner teams.

Requirements

  • Eight years of data engineering, including time as a technical lead.
  • Deep experience with SQL, Python and a columnar warehouse such as Snowflake.
  • A record of making slow, fragile pipelines boring and dependable.

We offer competitive pay, full health benefits and a yearly team week in Lisbon.
